lines.t: Beloved ones, I have spoken a multitude of words in your hearing, I have given a shout and poured out My spirit. Behold, I have whispered into the ears of this generation, to every man, woman and child. Yet who gave heed? Who stood up and proclaimed My coming? Who among men stood firm for who I truly am?! Who bowed down and gave Me glory? Who among this great multitude fell on their faces in true repentance? Who among those, who say they are My people, sought to make their repentance full?!

Yea, the little children gave heed, the hearts of the little ones skipped a beat; they, alone, embraced My voice. For they remember, and seek to return to the place from whence they came. Yet this foolish and most wicked generation despised Me in their zeal, and refused to give heed, plugging their ears when I called, turning their backs when I drew near!

Thus I removed My Spirit from the people and drew back My hand from the multitude, and they were forsaken - That they might stumble, that they might fall, that they might reap all they have sown in their arrogance, suffocating on account of their greed, until they drown in the depths of their vanity, to their own shame.

For I tell you the truth, that which is tipped can not be set upright again, and that which has been set in motion can not be stopped. Lo, even that which was held captive in the depths of silence has been released, behold, it comes forth, increasing by order of magnitude... And can in no wise be put back again, says The Lord.
